heading: I'm Laura, a psychospiritual practitioner based in
paragraphs: If you've tried everything to heal your mental and emotional health
I get it. I tried everything too. Medication. Talk therapy. Rehab. Psychiatric care. I TRIED EVERYTHING TO FEEL BETTER! Years in
I felt defeated Lost. Hopeless. BROKEN No amount of talking or medications could reach what was actually there. Unprocessed emotion and stored trauma

living in my body. Not just my mind. Then I found breathwork. My nervous system started to regulate. Emotions I had carried for years finally had somewhere to go. It was the first thing that worked at the level I needed. So I left my master's program in psychology. I left my career in dual diagnosis. I went all in. I had seen what happens when someone stops managing and masking their emotions and start moving through it.  Today I have nearly five years of breathwork experience. I've coached over hundreds of people. I've led over 80 events and more than a dozen retreats around the world. I bring a mental health background and lived experience into every session.  I don't offer quick symptom relief or coping tricks. We take a holistic approach with a strong emphasis on nervous system regulation.
facts: Going on 5 years of experience as a breathwork specialist.
Over 100 people coached by me to regulate their nervous system.
imageAlt: A moment of stillness in breathwork
pullQuote:
My work isn’t about coping, bypassing, or manifesting. You can’t think your way into freedom.
I take a full mind, body, and spirit approach. I combine grounded strategies with immersive techniques to help you heal at the root, not just manage the emotions.
